The link line is TARGET_FILES in api/wasm/indigo-ketcher/CMakeLists.txt at the commit (indigo-ketcher-object, indigo-static, indigo-inchi-static, indigo-renderer-static, render2d, lunasvg, plutovg, cairo, freetype, png, pixman, indigo-core, inchi, tinyxml2, z); the shipped file is the render build (target indigo-ketcher-separate, glue indigo-ketcher-separate-wasm.js, renamed by patch.cmake). Indigo has no NOTICE file at the commit (raw URL returns 404). Its LICENSE is the bare Apache-2.0 text with the unfilled appendix, byte-identical to node_modules/indigo-ketcher/LICENSE; the copyright lines are the only two forms in the headers of core/, api/c/indigo, api/c/indigo-inchi, api/c/indigo-renderer and api/wasm/indigo-ketcher (557 header lines say 2009; core/indigo-core/molecule/src/idt_alias.cpp says 2024). core/indigo-core/molecule/meta_commons.h has an 8-line pair hash "taken from boost library" (Boost licence, which asks nothing of binaries); not given its own entry. CDXConstants.h has its own component.

CMakeLists.txt only: Indigo commits 0be455d3a6a658698a04e76bbcca994a0ec84230, 93cd7b33798489aa6e587129e4d999cd8520855e, c9da0d7bc57bfe80d3d15b9711fb691f1e693c73, ab85e023158df9dbdcd1f69d0b57e8c39077dc1a.
components.evidence: Wasm strings "1.17.4" at file offset 9145285 (beside libpng's "1.6.54" at 9145266), "cairo_restore() without matching cairo_save()" at 9196397 and "invalid matrix (not invertible)" at 9193722. CMake target cairo (third_party/cairo/CMakeLists.txt) compiles src/*.c and boilerplate/*.c minus its REMOVE_ITEM list: 135 files under Emscripten (127 in src/, 8 in boilerplate/). src/cairo-fixed.c and src/cairo-freed-pool.c are removed only if (APPLE), and src/cairo-ft-font.c only if (NOT UNIX OR APPLE); Emscripten's CMake toolchain sets UNIX 1 (cmake/Modules/Platform/Emscripten.cmake), so all three are compiled (cairo-ft-font.c is how cairo reaches FreeType). The 8 boilerplate files go into libcairo.a but are not linked: none of their strings (e.g. "CAIRO_TEST_TARGET", "Known targets:", "POSIXLY_CORRECT") is in the wasm, so their Red Hat HPND and Mark K. Kim BSD notices are left out. Copyright lines, Initial Developer lines and licence classes come from the leading comments of the 127 compiled src/ files plus every header they reach by #include (234 files, an over-approximation that includes headers behind #if): 220 carry the LGPL-2.1/MPL-1.1 notice; the MIT files are cairo-tor-scan-converter.c, cairo-tor22-scan-converter.c, cairo-clip-tor-scan-converter.c, cairo-mono-scan-converter.c, cairo-spans.c, cairo-spans-private.h (one licence body, saved once from cairo-mono-scan-converter.c); the HPND files are cairo-pattern.c, cairo-time.c, cairo-time-private.h, cairo-freelist.c, cairo-freelist-private.h and cairo-freelist-type-private.h (four distinct bodies, each saved once); cairo-version.h and cairo-font-face-twin-data.c carry no notice. The snapshot was identified by comparing git blob hashes of Indigo's src/ with every upstream commit from 2020-11-20 to 2021-09-15 in a blobless clone of gitlab.freedesktop.org/cairo/cairo: 06f405c7 matches 358 of 374 files and no commit matches more. The cairo 1.17.4 release tarball (cairographics.org/snapshots/cairo-1.17.4.tar.xz, SHA-1 68712ae1039b114347be3b7200bc1c901d47a636 as published) differs from Indigo's copy in 87 files under src/, mostly upstream changes made after the release. COPYING-MPL-1.1 is byte-identical at 06f405c7, at the 1.17.4 tag (commit 156cd3eaaebfd8635517c2baf61fcf3627ff7ec2) and in the release tarball; Indigo's copy has no COPYING files.

components.evidence: Rebuilding the wasm's initial linear memory from its 3131 active data segments (wasm-opt splits the fonts between segments, so they are not contiguous in the file) gives four TrueType fonts at memory offsets 475200 (Bold Italic, sha256 24ee75f6239a83e8626a7d075159880616b9ce8f63855f866d48792a049436c9), 911776 (Bold, 27f21b493fe411f9cd080d20d4453f6c27f4bba908027fc24f72d85f855ea9db), 1513840 (Italic, 67f7e602de31ed36343e8b0b5e08c28274d08bfa52a621ea042dacbd802d76d1) and 1952640 (Regular, 13184522f1ce55a15667c6145f189c0c477b8e3ca77ba842d31527e0ee8c496b); each is byte-identical to the font rebuilt from Indigo's third_party/googlefonts/NotoSans_*.h. Every name table says ID 0 "Copyright 2015-2021 Google LLC. All Rights Reserved.", ID 7 "Noto is a trademark of Google LLC.", ID 13 the OFL 1.1 pointer, ID 5 "Version 2.007"; the UTF-16 copyright string is at wasm file offset 9655938. The base is google/fonts' static Noto Sans 2.007 (same name-ID 13 wording and table set; the noto-fonts builds carry ttfautohint and DSIG/STAT). OFL.txt at that google/fonts commit has the same copyright line as the fonts. The OFL declares no Reserved Font Name. Not used: Indigo's vendored third_party/googlefonts/OFL.txt and the .h comment headers, which name "The Open Sans Project Authors". The CJK fonts are not in this build (RENDER_ENABLE_CJK off).
